gaps.sentence: There were three ___ (BURGLE) on our street last month.
gaps.explanation: 'Three burglaries' — plural noun for the crime; burglars are people.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (OWN) of the car park charges by the hour.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — the person who owns it; 'ownership' is the state.

gaps.sentence: The hotel is ___ (CONVENIENT) situated near the station.
gaps.explanation: 'Conveniently situated' — the adverb modifies the participle.

gaps.sentence: The village is ___ (ACCESS) only by boat.
gaps.explanation: 'Accessible' = easy to reach; the -ible spelling follows 'access'.

gaps.sentence: The palace is open to ___ (VISIT) all year.

gaps.explanation: 'Needs revising' = needs to be revised — need + -ing.
